results.summary: In PostgreSQL `now()` / `current_timestamp` is frozen at transaction start; a holder of an old open transaction can back-date any timestamp the routine writes with it, so minimum-age and reset-window gates must stamp with `clock_timestamp()`.
results.need_to_read: 讀回該來源中 clock_timestamp() 在 minimum-age 與 reset-window gate 的使用位置及時間戳寫入注意事項。
